expenditures.detail: DELTA +0.07 (rows 4,782.72 vs stated 4,782.65). Both figures retained verbatim; NOTHING was adjusted. The three Exhibit B amounts were re-read in a 600 dpi tight crop and are unambiguous ($77.67 + $1,284.28 + $3,420.77 = $4,782.72), and the handwritten total was re-read in its own 600 dpi crop and unambiguously reads '$4,782.65'. The seven cents is the FILER's arithmetic error, carried through to Summary Page line 2 Column A, which prints the same $4,782.65.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: The on-form 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' cells on p3 and p4 are EMPTY (both on-form schedules are blank and hand-marked 'SEE EXHIBIT "A"/"B" ATTACHED'); only the TOTAL cells are filled. Gate therefore applied at the schedule-total level: Schedule A GATES exactly (Exhibit A rows 3,355.00 = handwritten total 3,355.00); Schedule B DOES NOT GATE - Exhibit B rows 4,782.72 vs handwritten total 4,782.65, a 7c filer discrepancy that survived escalation on both sides of the comparison.
itemized.escalation_note: 600 dpi tight cell crops x3: (1) the Exhibit B amount column, to test whether a mis-read digit explained the 7c gap - it did not, all three amounts are crisp; (2) the p4 handwritten TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE cell - unambiguously '$4,782.65'; (3) the p3 handwritten TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED cell - '$3,355.00'. Plus a 400 dpi crop of Exhibit A's name+address columns to establish that the one-initial donor names are a redaction and not the printed text.
itemized.notes: 6-page filing (David Wilde, Salt Lake County Council District No. 3, year-end 1-31-07): p1 cover, p2 Summary Page, p3 on-form Schedule A blank + 'SEE EXHIBIT "A" ATTACHED' with only the TOTAL filled ($3,355.00), p4 on-form Schedule B blank + 'SEE EXHIBIT "B" ATTACHED' with only the TOTAL filled ($4,782.65), p5 = EXHIBIT A (typed letterhead list, 'CONTRIBUTIONS / 11/1/06 - FINAL', hand-paginated 'PAGE 5 of 6'), p6 = EXHIBIT B ('EXPENDITURES / 11/1/06 - FINAL', 'PAGE 6 of 6'). The itemized rows live on pp.5-6, not on the county form. PRIVACY/redaction: on Exhibit A the ADDRESS column is whited out and the five INDIVIDUAL donor names are reduced to a single leading initial ('G.', 'C.', 'F.', 'A.', 'V.') while the four organisational names survive in full - those five rows are emitted at confidence=low with needs_review=1 and are NEVER completed to a plausible name. THE EXPENDITURE SIDE DOES NOT RECONCILE: rows total 4,782.72 against a printed 4,782.65. Escalation at 600 dpi on both the rows and the total left the 7c gap standing, so it is recorded as filer arithmetic with both figures named - no row was adjusted to close it.
